name: calcQFQ
desc: 用于基于复权因子表计算股票日线或者分钟行情的前复权价格，按每只股票最新复权因子将 open、low、high、close、upLimitPrice、downLimitPrice、prevClosePrice 统一换算为前复权口径。
notes: 该函数用于对股票日线或者分钟行情行情表执行前复权处理。
priceTbl 必须包含字段：symbol, tradeTime, open, low, high, close, volume, amount, upLimitPrice, downLimitPrice, prevClosePrice。
priceTbl 可以额外包含 singal 列；若存在，该列会在返回结果中原样保留。
factorTbl 必须包含字段：code, trade_date, adj_factor。
函数会根据 priceTbl 的 tradeTime 自动推导查询日期区间，并仅加载该区间内的复权因子。
函数会按 symbol 计算区间内最新的复权因子 latest_adj_factor，并使用 adj_factor / latest_adj_factor 对价格字段进行前复权换算。
若某条记录缺少 adj_factor 或 latest_adj_factor，则对应价格字段保持原值，不做复权换算。
volume 与 amount 不做复权换算，保持原值返回。
返回结果字段顺序与 priceTbl 保持一致；若输入存在 singal 列，输出也包含 singal 列。

priceTbl.desc: 待复权的行情表，需包含字段：symbol, tradeTime, open, low, high, close, volume, amount, upLimitPrice, downLimitPrice, prevClosePrice；可选包含 singal

factorTbl.desc: 复权因子表，需包含字段：code, trade_date, adj_factor, update_time

return.desc: 返回按最新复权因子折算后的前复权行情表，结构与 priceTbl 一致；若输入包含 singal 列则输出也包含该列

singal.desc: 可选列；若输入 priceTbl 包含 singal，则原样透传

body:
def calcQFQ(priceTbl, factorTbl){

    p = select *,date(tradeTime) as trade_date from priceTbl

    dateRange = exec trade_date from p
    startDate = dateRange.min()
    endDate = dateRange.max()

    cols = schema(priceTbl)["colDefs"]["name"]
    hasSingal = `singal in cols

    f = select code, trade_date, adj_factor from factorTbl where trade_date between startDate : endDate

    j = lj(p, f, `symbol`trade_date, `code`trade_date)

    latestFactor = select symbol, last(adj_factor) as latest_adj_factor
                   from (
                        select symbol, trade_date, adj_factor
                        from j
                        where not isNull(adj_factor)
                        order by symbol, trade_date
                   )
                   group by symbol

    // 7. 合并最新复权因子
    t = lj(j, latestFactor, `symbol, `symbol)

    // 8. 分支返回：有 singal 和无 singal 两种情况
    if(hasSingal){
        return select
                    symbol,
                    tradeTime,
                    iif(isNull(adj_factor) or isNull(latest_adj_factor), open, open * adj_factor / latest_adj_factor) as open,
                    iif(isNull(adj_factor) or isNull(latest_adj_factor), low, low * adj_factor / latest_adj_factor) as low,
                    iif(isNull(adj_factor) or isNull(latest_adj_factor), high, high * adj_factor / latest_adj_factor) as high,
                    iif(isNull(adj_factor) or isNull(latest_adj_factor), close, close * adj_factor / latest_adj_factor) as close,
                    volume,
                    amount,
                    iif(isNull(adj_factor) or isNull(latest_adj_factor), upLimitPrice, upLimitPrice * adj_factor / latest_adj_factor) as upLimitPrice,
                    iif(isNull(adj_factor) or isNull(latest_adj_factor), downLimitPrice, downLimitPrice * adj_factor / latest_adj_factor) as downLimitPrice,
                    iif(isNull(adj_factor) or isNull(latest_adj_factor), prevClosePrice, prevClosePrice * adj_factor / latest_adj_factor) as prevClosePrice,
                    singal
               from t
    }else{
        return select
                    symbol,
                    tradeTime,
                    iif(isNull(adj_factor) or isNull(latest_adj_factor), open, open * adj_factor / latest_adj_factor) as open,
                    iif(isNull(adj_factor) or isNull(latest_adj_factor), low, low * adj_factor / latest_adj_factor) as low,
                    iif(isNull(adj_factor) or isNull(latest_adj_factor), high, high * adj_factor / latest_adj_factor) as high,
                    iif(isNull(adj_factor) or isNull(latest_adj_factor), close, close * adj_factor / latest_adj_factor) as close,
                    volume,
                    amount,
                    iif(isNull(adj_factor) or isNull(latest_adj_factor), upLimitPrice, upLimitPrice * adj_factor / latest_adj_factor) as upLimitPrice,
                    iif(isNull(adj_factor) or isNull(latest_adj_factor), downLimitPrice, downLimitPrice * adj_factor / latest_adj_factor) as downLimitPrice,
                    iif(isNull(adj_factor) or isNull(latest_adj_factor), prevClosePrice, prevClosePrice * adj_factor / latest_adj_factor) as prevClosePrice
               from t
    }
}
